name: explore-mode
description: EXplore: an open methodology for AI-supported inquiry and learning. A router, research workflows, thinking-method playbooks, and principles that keep evidence traceable, preserve uncertainty and disagreement, encourage independent views across models, protect data and cultural authority, and keep the learner as the author and decision-maker.

openalex_api_key.title: OpenAlex API key (optional)
openalex_api_key.description: Raises EXplore's daily allowance for scholarly search through OpenAlex. Free from https://openalex.org/settings/api-key. Leave blank to search without one.

semantic_scholar_api_key.title: Semantic Scholar API key (optional)
semantic_scholar_api_key.description: Gives EXplore its own Semantic Scholar rate limit instead of the busy shared one. Request one free at https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/api#api-key-form. Leave blank to search without one.
